verdict.rationale: Image input is first-party documented: reasoning models 'accept text and image inputs' via the Responses and Chat Completions APIs, and GPT-5.5's capability set lists image input. Audio input is covered through the realtime voice and WebRTC guides (microphone input, full-duplex voice), and documents can feed responses through file search. The old community remark that visual inputs weren't yet available dates from GPT-4's launch and doesn't contradict the current docs. Missing for 10: a dedicated vision/image-input guide with request examples, direct document/PDF input as opposed to file-search retrieval, audio input documented on the standard (non-realtime) request path, and independent hands-on corroboration.
